decisions.question: What sign-off does this change to billing, plans, credits or pricing need before it merges?
decisions.opening: Overdue invoices get a late fee after thirty days, on by default.
options: You state in the PR description what changes for customers
Whoever owns billing signs off, here or by linking where they already did
option_reasons: a short written account puts on record what customers will see
they know the pricing rules this touches
when customers see no change from it yet, for example while it is off
decisions.reason: It takes you one paragraph, and it gives whoever owns billing something concrete to agree with.
decisions.why: No agent checks money logic, so a person has to confirm what it changes.

where.what: Overdue invoices now get a late fee after thirty days.
The fee amount is read from the plan settings.
The invoice shows the fee on its own line.

decisions.scope: Billing, plans, credits or pricing are outside this review.
